argument: The refusal must be carried by several routes repeating one hook and leaving with one altered cadence; the amber witness cannot do the explanatory work.
With witnesses and labels hidden, a viewer should see a family of handwriting routes hesitate in the same local gesture before continuing. If it reads as a generic wave, the mutation fails.
Placing a stutter must alter route points and the after-cadence, not only a counter. Lifting the latest stutter must reproduce the exact preceding field from pointer, button, and keyboard paths.
Shared hesitation is an easy metaphor. Delete v007 if hiding the witness leaves only a decorative loop, if only one route repeats, or if the copy explains more stutter than the handwriting can show.
